text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen—and the
first round
of the Cutie ♪ Derby—is
finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taking inspiration from Каррен Тян's
videos,
Бико Пегасус has also leveled up
her hero videos
for the big day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян, on the other hand, presses
on as
usual with cute videos.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After admiring and praising each other's
work,
they both declare the intent to
take first place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
